name: bito-video
description: Vídeo de producto y material gráfico de Bito, hechos con Remotion

scripts.verificar: bash scripts/verificar-video.sh out/bito-promo-es.mp4 && bash scripts/verificar-video.sh out/bito-promo-en.mp4
scripts.render:borrador: npm run audio && npm run render:es && npm run render:en && npm run verificar
scripts.shots: python3 shots/run_shots.py --lang es,en --screens all && python3 shots/verify_shots.py
scripts.final: vitest run && npm run render && npm run store
